stage0024_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ person still won't tell us
　why she's after $$マーティアル$$,
　will she?」

stage0024_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's just how she is.
　Asking about what she won't say is pointless.」

stage0024_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$n
「She was apparently a ZEXIS member too,
　but seems to hold quite a unique position.」

stage0024_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$...
　An officer of the Black Knights, right
　hand to leader $$ゼロ$$ and rumored lover.」

stage0024_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Keeping a cutie like that around means
　$$ゼロ$$'s really a guy after all...」

stage0024_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$クルツ$$
「But that $$ゼロ$$'s not around.
　Might as well get friendly while I can...」

stage0024_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Be careful, $$クルツ$$.
　$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$'s nickname is the Witch, you know.」

stage0024_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Nice, a bewitching woman...
　Sounds like a fun thrill.」

stage0024_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Um, well, $$クルツ$$...
　that's not what it means.」

stage0024_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ルカ$$
「She's a witch in the literal sense.」

stage0024_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What, so that cute look's just magic
　and she's really some wrinkled old hag
　who's hundreds of years old?」

stage0024_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're not far off, actually.
　Better not to approach her out of curiosity.」

stage0024_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$クルツ$$
「While we were talking, some surprising
　guy went and beat me to it!」

stage0024_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「It's been a while, $$ル・シャッコ$$.
　I never expected to meet you again.」

stage0024_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Don't make such a scary face.
　A woman won't open up to that.」

stage0024_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Why are you after $$マーティアル$$?」

stage0024_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I told you, didn't I?
　That sort just doesn't sit well with me.」

stage0024_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「I doubt that's the only reason.
　...Where's $$ゼロ$$?」

stage0024_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I got tired of babysitting the boy.
　So I threw him out.」

stage0024_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「So you don't intend to answer.」

stage0024_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Not quite.
　In fact, I have something I want to ask you too.」

stage0024_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「What do you think a god is?」

stage0024_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「...I don't know.
　I don't believe in $$マーティアル$$ anyway.」

stage0024_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Typical of a Quentian who exiled abnormals.」

stage0024_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Are you saying a god is an abnormal?」

stage0024_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's exactly why I'm
　chasing after $$マーティアル$$.」

stage0024_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Then I'll ask you.
　What do you think a god is?」

stage0024_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「And a god is an immortal being.」

stage0024_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Then are you a god, since you never die?」

stage0024_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Let me elaborate.
　Gods are immortal, and they wished to be.」

stage0024_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「And they're aware that they are gods.」

stage0024_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$n
「That story... tell me more about it.」

stage0024_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$n
「It's $F.
　Tell me what you know about gods.」

stage0024_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$n
「What do you mean...?
　I'm the $$ジェニオン$$'s pilot...」

stage0024_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm sorry.
　Did $n do something wrong?」

stage0024_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh, I'm $$西条涼音$$, the assistant
　homeroom teacher for his class.」

stage0024_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes.
　He and I, and $$宗介$$ and $$アルト$$ too,
　attend school when there's no fighting.」

stage0024_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You said $n, right...
　What do you want?」

stage0024_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Are you prepared to give up
　your ordinary life for that?」

stage0024_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... it brings back memories.
　Of when I met that man.」

stage0024_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Very well, $n.
　If you want to know about gods, come with me.」

stage0024_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Um... going with her... to where?」

stage0024_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Our foe is a massive religious group.
　Even to get $$フィアナ$$ back, we should
　try to proceed without stirring trouble.」

stage0024_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Is that $$マーティアル$$'s temple?」

stage0024_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$n
「No... that's a Mayan ruin.
　They're probably using it as a temple.」

stage0024_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$n
「Old Century, a civilization that flourished
　long ago in Central and South America, known
　for skilled astronomy and an accurate calendar.」

stage0024_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Moreover, that calendar once drew
　worldwide attention for recording
　the time of the world's end.」

stage0024_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$宗介$$
「A doomsday prophecy...
　Some kind of occult nonsense?」

stage0024_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$n
「Don't dismiss it as unscientific.
　Legends and prophecies like that
　sometimes carry some grain of truth.」

stage0024_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$n
「The doomsday prophecy $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ mentioned
　came from the Mayan calendar, split into
　the Ages of Beast, Water, Wind, Fire, Sun...」

stage0024_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$n
「Since it ends along with the Age of
　the Sun, it's said to prophesy
　the end of humanity.」

stage0024_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$宗介$$
「Ridiculous.
　And yet humanity has survived past the end.」

stage0024_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$キリコ$$
「That's enough.
　The guard just went out on patrol.」

stage0024_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$宗介$$
「It's about time for the operation.
　The Quarter will show up head on
　and serve as our decoy.」

stage0024_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$n
「Meanwhile, we'll push into the temple
　and rescue $$フィアナ$$ ourselves.」

stage0024_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$宗介$$
「...So we managed to infiltrate, somehow.」

stage0024_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　Major $$カリーニン$$'s team is almost certain
　the AT that took her is here.」

stage0024_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$n
「$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$...
　why did you bring me here?」

stage0024_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I'll ask first.
　Why do you question the existence of gods?」

stage0024_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$n
「But if I can understand what a god is,
　it will decide how I fight from here on.」

stage0024_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「...Very well.
　Then take a look at those who've
　been captivated by it, right here.」

stage0024_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I see you want to solve your own problem
　yourself. I'm used to boys like that.」

stage0024_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... I'll have you know,
　that man hasn't changed either.」

stage0024_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$n
（She must mean $$ゼロ$$, the Black Knights' supreme
　commander. Apparently he was part of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, too.）

stage0024_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Didn't expect to meet you in a place like this.
　I'm thrilled, Kashiiim!」

stage0024_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Obviously.
　My unit had a Lambda Driver
　loaded in it too, you know.」

stage0024_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$n
「This guy...!
　He's the one from the Hanka Autonomous Region!」

stage0024_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Hahaha!
　Never thought I'd get to repay that old debt
　in a place exactly like this!」

stage0024_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't die easily on me, Kashim!
　Since we're here, let's enjoy this fully!」

stage0024_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$キリコ$$!
　$n and I will handle things here!」

stage0024_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$n
「You go!
　Go and get $$フィアナ$$ out of here!」

stage0024_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「No more business from here on!
　Let's have some fun, my dear Kashim!」

stage0024_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$キリコ$$
（$$フィアナ$$... where are you...!）

stage0024_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「No need to be surprised.
　This is my power.」

stage0024_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$キリコ$$
「That voice... the woman who took $$フィアナ$$?」

stage0024_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
Teitania
「I am $$テイタニア・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$.」

stage0024_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$キリコ$$
「That move just now... are you a $$ＰＳ$$ as well?」

stage0024_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I am a 《$$ネクスタント$$》,
　and the 13th Rank Shield of Order.」

stage0024_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$キリコ$$
「...If this woman is here,
　then $$フィアナ$$ must be here too.」

stage0024_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「An attack with the killing intent suppressed...
　Now that surprised me.」

stage0024_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「No wonder you're surprised.
　The bullet you fired did hit me.」

stage0024_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「But I am a $$ネクスタント$$.
　I can control pain.」

stage0024_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$キリコ$$
（A mechanical body...
　The same as that man, $$ニーバ$$...?）

stage0024_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「But I won't rely on function... on my aux-brain.」

stage0024_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$... I ask you this.
　Do you believe in $$マーティアル$$'s god?」

stage0024_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'll take that attitude as a denial.
　Then, I will defeat you.」

stage0024_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Even if you are the Untouchable!」

stage0024_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$アルト$$
「Calling off the search for $$フィアナ$$...!?」

stage0024_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Given $$マーティアル$$'s been behind these incidents,
　we need to handle this with the utmost care.」

stage0024_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「If her abduction were just one branch
　acting alone, we could manage. But the roots
　seem to reach the Order's headquarters.」

stage0024_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$アルト$$
「So you're telling me to give up on $$フィアナ$$!?」

stage0024_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Calm down, $$アルト$$.
　This isn't just a personal matter anymore.」

stage0024_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「At the very least, since $$マーティアル$$ is plotting
　some antisocial action, we intend to seek out
　ways to pursue this ourselves.」

stage0024_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Of course, I'd rather avoid all-out conflict.」

stage0024_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$アルト$$
「So, when it comes to $$フィアナ$$,
　all I can do is wait until then...!」

stage0024_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「In conclusion, yes, that's how it stands.」

stage0024_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$キリコ$$... what do you intend to do?」

stage0024_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Knowing him...
　I thought he'd leave $$ミスリル$$ just to chase $$フィアナ$$...」

stage0024_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't tell me... he actually gave up...」

stage0024_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$クラン$$
「There's no way $$キリコ$$ would give up on $$フィアナ$$!
　Don't you all get it!?
　The reason he's choosing not to chase her!」

stage0024_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$カナリア$$
「$$フィアナ$$'s body is the reason.」

stage0024_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$クラン$$
「$$キリコ$$ knows that even if he got $$フィアナ$$ back
　right now, there'd be nothing he could do!」

stage0024_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$カナリア$$
「$$マーティアル$$ has the technology to create $$ＰＳ$$...
　If anyone could heal $$フィアナ$$'s body right now,
　it would only be them.」

stage0024_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that's why he's... choosing not to...」

stage0024_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$オズマ$$
「That's how it is.
　Try to understand how $$キリコ$$ feels.」

stage0024_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「This concludes the mission, Black $$バトリング$$.
　We'll relay what we learned to the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$,
　then rejoin the other units in Japan.」

stage0024_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「In space, Neo Zeon's movements are intensifying,
　and a new enemy has apparently appeared in Japan.」

stage0024_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ルカ$$
「And there's also $$マーティアル$$...」

stage0024_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$n
「And the Unknowns that backed them up...」

stage0024_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even after surviving the $$新世時空震動$$,
　the world's heading toward war again...」

stage0024_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$オズマ$$
「We're here to deal with situations like this!
　There's no time to mope!」

stage0024_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$オズマ$$
「If you know it, get ready to head out.
　Listen... don't forget, we protect peace by fighting.」

stage0024_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（A power that surpasses the will of god...）

stage0024_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Who knows?
　I'll keep confirming that for myself.」

stage0024_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「You planning to come along with us?」

stage0024_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's exactly what I intend to do.
　Besides, if you're headed to Japan, that suits me.
　I want to give that thing to him, after all.」

stage0024_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Fine.
　I want to see what you're chasing after too.」

stage0024_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... good to work with you again,
　warrior of $$クエント$$ who cast out god.」

stage0024_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Come to think of it, where's Miss $$スズネ$$...?」

stage0024_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「It seems she was called by the captain earlier...」

stage0024_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Word is,
　Captain $$ジェフリー$$'s been a widower a good while.」

stage0024_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$クルツ$$
「And get this, despite how he looks he's popular.
　Word is someone on the bridge's gone soft for him.」

stage0024_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Wow, $$クルツ$$... you sure hear things fast.」

stage0024_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You sure about that?
　The captain might be making a move on Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0024_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What'll it be, $n?
　If you're going to crash it, I'll lend a hand.」

stage0024_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$n
「...It's got nothing to do with me.
　Miss $$スズネ$$ is my partner, that's all,
　and nothing more than that.」

stage0024_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$カナリア$$
（No, that's not it.
　That isn't romantic feeling.）

stage0024_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$n
「I... I've got $$ジェニオン$$ maintenance to do...」

stage0024_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ルカ$$
「$$クルツ$$, don't tell me...
　you did that to make $n
　realize his own feelings?」

stage0024_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$宗介$$
「Negative, $$ルカ$$.
　This one is after Miss $$スズネ$$ of his own accord.」

stage0024_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Whoa!
　Sharp, for a stone-face sergeant!」

stage0024_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$クラン$$
「Figured it was something like that...!」

stage0024_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Still, what could the captain want with Miss $$スズネ$$...」

stage0024_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「If that's really an approach,
　Sergeant Major $$モニカ$$ would go off the deep end.」

stage0024_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$カナリア$$
「No need to worry about that.」

stage0024_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アルト$$
「Do you know something, Lt. $$カナリア$$?」

stage0024_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$カナリア$$
（The captain's probably noticed too...）

stage0024_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「My apologies for taking your time
　when you must be busy.」

stage0024_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I heard his unwavering resolve, and
　approved boarding the $$ジェニオン$$
　and enlisting with $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$...」

stage0024_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Perhaps that was a mistake.」

stage0024_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Lately I've come to think
　$F may not truly be
　suited to fighting at all.」

stage0024_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$スズネ$$
（$$キリコ$$ said something similar...）

stage0024_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「From what the crew says,
　they strongly resist letting anyone
　uninvolved in battle be put at risk.」

stage0024_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'd noticed that myself.
　It's likely tied to his father and sister,
　who I hear died in an accident...」

stage0024_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's likely why he's shut away his heart
　and is forcing himself to fight.」

stage0024_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As far as I can tell, he always seems
　to be fighting fear itself. I thought it was
　just inexperience, but the root runs deeper.」

stage0024_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's only natural to fear battle.
　But $n has been overcoming that
　and fighting anyway.」

stage0024_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That is precisely why it's dangerous.」

stage0024_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「His eyes are full of deep anger and grief.
　...Eyes sworn to revenge for what was taken.」

stage0024_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Of course, everyone has their own reasons to fight,
　so I won't pull him from the $$ジェニオン$$ over this.」

stage0024_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But we'll need to keep an eye on his actions.」

stage0024_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$... surely, in the battles ahead,
　a time will come when he opens up his heart.」

stage0024_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Please remember this.
　Anger too strong can destroy
　not just oneself, but those nearby too.」

stage0024_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...Understood, Captain $$ジェフリー$$.
　I may not be much help, but...
　I do mean to be his partner.」

stage0024_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$スズネ$$
「When that time comes,
　I'll be sure to protect $n's heart.」

stage0024_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'm counting on you, Miss $$スズネ$$.
　If he can overcome that...」

stage0024_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Surely he'll gain the power he seeks.」

stage0024_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...I'll report on the operation's progress so far.」

stage0024_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Impatient, aren't you...
　Can't even wait for your superior's glass to empty?」

stage0024_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Now that rank means nothing anymore,
　there's no hierarchy between you and me.」

stage0024_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「If you're going to call yourself my superior,
　you might try acting like one.」

stage0024_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's such a dull assignment,
　so let me enjoy a game and a drink
　in peace. You get it, don't you, honey?」

stage0024_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Quit clicking your tongue.
　It sours the drink with the world's cares.」

stage0024_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...May I report now?」

stage0024_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Wrap it up before my next drink arrives.」

stage0024_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Things in space show some slight deviation,
　but overall it's proceeding as planned.」

stage0024_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「For Japan, I moved the forces per your orders,
　but a similar deviation has occurred there too.」

stage0024_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Also, as for 《$$マーティアル$$》,
　it should be safe to say things are on schedule here.」

stage0024_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So space and Japan both have deviations...
　In your judgment, is that a level worth worrying about?」

stage0024_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「To confirm that, I intend to go check
　the uncertain factor myself.」

stage0024_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Roger that.
　I'll step out for a bit while you're gone.」

stage0024_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Where do you intend to go?」

stage0024_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Time I go pay respects to this planet's
　caretaker. Seems they're in quite a panic
　over our appearance, trying to do their job.」

stage0024_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...So this speeds things up, does it.」

stage0024_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「The countdown's already begun.
　Let's enjoy the game till the clock strikes zero.」

stage0024_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「While everyone else treats me coldly,
　you're the first to come visit me
　on your own, Master $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$」

stage0024_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So what can I do for you?」

stage0024_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「No... I just came to see your face.
　I heard you're one of that $n's guardians.」

stage0024_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Could it be, Master $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$...
　you're interested in $n?」

stage0024_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「In that one, and everything around him.」

stage0024_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...!
　So that's why you came to see me too!」

stage0024_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, ask me anything!
　I'll cooperate with all my heart and soul!」

stage0024_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Actually, someone like you, Master $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$,
　is just my type. Scold me with those cold eyes
　and my brain shorts out, heart goes tweet-tweet!」

stage0024_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I'm no good at pleasing people.
　...What I want from you, I'll get to bit by bit.」

stage0024_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But looking forward to what's to come,
　I'll stay fired up today too... Business, business!」
